content_blocks.label: clause_1._Scope_of_Services
content_blocks.text: The Consultant shall provide professional services hereinafter referred to as 'Services'. These services include but are not limited to consulting, analysis, and report preparation.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Compensation
content_blocks.text: The Client shall pay the Consultant the sum of $500 per hour for all hours worked on the project.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Confidentiality
content_blocks.text: All information disclosed by either party during the term of this agreement shall be kept confidential and not disclosed to any third party without prior written consent.
